import itertools
import string
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func():
    alphabet = string.ascii_lowercase

    # Generate all possible 3-letter combinations
    combinations = [''.join(chars) for chars in itertools.product(alphabet, repeat=3)]

    # Create a DataFrame from the combinations
    df = pd.DataFrame({'combination': combinations})

    # Compute frequencies of the first letters
    first_letters = df['combination'].str[0]
    counts = first_letters.value_counts().sort_index()

    # Draw the histogram/bar chart of first-letter frequencies
    fig, ax = plt.subplots()
    ax.bar(counts.index, counts.values)
    ax.set_xlabel('First letter')
    ax.set_ylabel('Frequency')
    ax.set_title('Frequency of First Letters in 3-Letter Combinations')

    return df, ax
